title: jmap-client: port ws/ (WebSocket session)
description: Port WebSocket session from crate-jmapchat-client/src/ws/mod.rs into crate-jmap-client/src/ws/mod.rs. This is NOT a verbatim copy: Chat-specific frame variants must be removed, Invocation type shape has changed, and RFC 8887 compliance requires adding an @type field that the reference implementation is missing.
design: Copy WsSession and WsFrame. REMOVE WsFrame::ChatTyping and WsFrame::ChatPresence variants — these are Chat extension events. Replace jmapchat_types:: imports with jmap_types:: equivalents. IMPORTANT: jmapchat-client's Invocation is a named struct {method, args, call_id}; jmap-types Invocation is a tuple (String, Value, String) — update all tuple field accesses accordingly (index 0=method, 1=args, 2=call_id). RFC 8887 COMPLIANCE FIX: add @type: 'Request' field to outgoing WebSocket JMAP request frames (§4.3.2 requires this; jmapchat-client omits it — this is a protocol bug that must be fixed here, not copied).
